author: Channel 5 with Andrew Callaghan
description:
Hey guys. Currently in crippling legal debt from our last round defending ourselves against bullshittin' Bill Joiner in federal court, we are in a dire financial situation as we move to the next battle in State court and must ask for help. Please donate to our legal defense at: https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-channel-5-fight-frivolous-lawsuit 

Also, if you're in interested in watching our film 'Dear Kelly,' which sparked this lawsuit, head to https://www.dearkellyfilm.com. We've decided to make the film FREE for the weekend, as it pertains to the case. Simply use code DEARKELLY26 at check-out to give the movie a watch. 

Best,
Andrew Callaghan
title: We're Being Sued
